settings.tagline: Smell it before you choose. The collection comes to you.

settings.title: The wash
settings.description: Starts it. The first layer of scent, and it cleans without fighting what comes next.

settings.title: The cream
settings.description: Holds it. Fragrance lasts on moisturized skin, so the cream carries the scent through the day.

settings.title: The mist or body spray
settings.description: Finishes it. The part people notice. Mist for her. For him, a deodorizing body spray: scent and freshness that hold up in the heat.

settings.heading: One scent, three forms, each with a job.
settings.intro: Most sellers sell the mist on its own, and it fades by afternoon. Every set in this house starts with all three, because the scent only lasts when they work together.

settings.title: Sourced sealed
settings.text: Every piece arrives from the source sealed, with its batch code, and is inspected before it's listed.

settings.title: Checked at your door
settings.text: Pay securely by mobile money or card, then check your set when it arrives. If anything is damaged, incomplete, or not what you ordered, message us and we'll put it right.

settings.title: Delivered across Ghana
settings.text: Delivery within Accra is included. Outside Accra, sets travel by VIP bus, and the station fee is paid on pickup.
